data.title: What switching hosts ask us.
items: Do I have to close my WhatsApp group?
No. Most hosts keep it for chat and photos and pin the booking link. Bookings, payments and reminders move to Catch.
Guest lists into an event, from a CSV or Excel file, and form responses from Google Forms or Typeform as applications. Match your columns, check the preview and import.
Will my guests have to sign up?
They book on your page in their phone’s browser with their phone number. No app to download.
I still have events on sale elsewhere.
Leave them there and put your next event on Catch. You can import those guest lists afterwards.
Can I take my data out again?
Yes. Export your contacts from Catch Host whenever you like.
Nothing for 30 days from your first event on Catch, or 90 for founding hosts. Then 5% of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 a month. Moving your data is free.
